zh.title: 工研院攜手奇美等成立塑膠包材循環示範聯盟
zh.summary: 工研院攜手奇美及中華航空等；成立廢塑膠包材轉化循環輕油示範聯盟
body: 工研院今天宣布，攜手奇美實業、全家便利商店、台灣希普思、唯信公司、中華航空，以及熱裂解油供應商海神全球，成立「廢塑膠包材轉化循環輕油應用示範聯盟」，建立廢塑膠包材轉化為循環石化料源的示範模式。
工研院材料與化工研究所所長邱國展表示，工研院開發高效能除雜吸附材料與催化劑技術，將塑膠裂解油升級為符合石化原料規格的循環輕油，相較於焚化發電回收模式，可減少約50%碳排放。
邱國展表示，聯盟將驗證聚烯烴循環產業模式的可行性，並串聯跨產業夥伴建構循環供應鏈，未來持續擴大示範與吸引更多企業投入。
中華航空永續長鄭智仁表示，期望透過參與聯盟，以實際行動推動資源循環、責任生產與服務、能源轉型及氣候行動。

en.title: Taiwan's ITRI Forms Alliance with Chi Mei, Others for Plastic Recycling Demonstration
en.summary: ITRI partners with Chi Mei, China Airlines and others to launch a plastic waste recycling demonstration alliance for circular light oil.
body: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) announced today that it has formed the Waste Plastic Packaging Conversion Circular Light Oil Demonstration Alliance with Chi Mei Industrial, FamilyMart, Taiwan Chips, Vicome, China Airlines, and pyrolysis oil supplier Poseidon Global, to establish a demonstration model for converting waste plastic packaging into circular petrochemical feedstock.

ITRI Materials and Chemical Research Laboratories Director Chiu Kuo-chan said the institute has developed high-efficiency adsorption materials and catalyst technologies that upgrade plastic cracking oil into circulating light oil meeting petrochemical feedstock specifications, with a carbon reduction of about 50% compared to incineration power generation.
Chiu noted that the alliance aims to verify the feasibility of the polyolefin circular industry model and build a cross-industry circular supply chain.
China Airlines Sustainability Officer Eric Cheng said the company hopes to support resource circulation, energy transition and climate action by participating in the alliance.
